_readme: Photos and artwork on the site. To add one: drop the file in images/,
add an entry here. Nothing else needs touching.
role    — 'crest'   the club badge in the masthead. Artwork, not graded.
'hero'    behind the masthead. First one wins.
'band'    full width, keeps its own proportions. For wide shots
too panoramic to crop into a panel.
'gallery' the scrolling rail near the foot of the page.
target  — for role 'panel'. Any section with a data-panel attribute:
headline, scott, next, market, bracket. Panels that are mostly
small numbers read better left clean.
focus   — CSS object-position. Nudge if a crop cuts someone's head off.
'50% 20%' pulls the crop up, '20% 50%' shifts the subject right.
Has no effect where the image already fits without cropping.
alt     — read aloud by screen readers. Describe it, don't caption it.
credit  — shown small under gallery and band photos. Empty hides it.
Order matters in the gallery: the rail shows these left to right.
Unknown roles and targets are ignored, and any file that fails to load
takes itself out cleanly, so nothing here can break the page.
